rationale: Executive Order 13362 (69 FR 70173) is held as an official Federal Register text. Section 2 of Executive Order 13442 of August 13, 2007 (72 FR 45877-45878, held FR text) states that Executive Order 13362 of November 29, 2004 is hereby revoked; the revocation is of the whole order with no deferral or saving wording, and the held text of 6 U.S.C. 111 repeats it. No earlier ending or contrary later instrument was found in the held corpus (4 files name the order). It was therefore not in force on 2026-10-14. The single history observation is OFR editorial data recording this revocation.
